changelog: BIM-Bot v2.6.1 — total uninstall. FIX: uninstall now removes everything: the app folder (generated launcher/config files are deleted so the folder on C: no longer survives), Revit manifests + copied DLLs in both per-user and machine scopes for 2020-2027 (all folder names: BIMBot, BIMBotPlugin, RevitMCP), %APPDATA%/%LOCALAPPDATA% BIMBot runtime data (logs, settings, license, ProjectData, handshake), and the BIM-Bot entry in all 8 MCP client configs (Claude Desktop incl. MS Store, Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Gemini CLI, VS Code, VS Code Insiders) with .bimbot-backup. NEW: configure-claude.cjs --remove mode. Locked files are removed on reboot instead of lingering, and uninstall warns if Revit is still open.
